subject.title: fix(channels): honor empty catalog docs prefixes

question: Should an explicit empty `selectionDocsPrefix` be a supported durable channel-plugin metadata value that suppresses the default `Docs:` label, including for persisted installed-package metadata?
rationale: The code correctly implements either interpretation, but accepting the empty-string distinction establishes a compatibility contract for external channel plugins and existing installed metadata.

options.title: Accept the explicit-empty contract
options.body: Merge the patch and treat omitted prefixes as default-label behavior while treating `""` as an intentional request to omit that label.

options.title: Keep truthy-only metadata semantics
options.body: Reject this contract change and require plugin authors to use a different documented representation if label suppression is needed.

recommendation.title: Accept the explicit-empty contract
recommendation.body: Merge the patch and treat omitted prefixes as default-label behavior while treating `""` as an intentional request to omit that label.
